svg.aria-label: How farmers dodge fire satellites: a polar-orbiting satellite passes over Punjab around 1:30 PM and flags active fires; between 2020 and 2024 farmers shifted peak stubble burning to about 5 PM, after the overpass, so many fires go uncounted while the smoke still reaches Delhi.
svg.text: How farmers dodge the fire satellites
peak burn shifted 1:30 PM → 5 PM (2020–2024) to slip past the overpass
The official fire count falls; the smoke over Delhi does not. Source: NASA Earth Observatory, 2025.
